title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Mark 8: the four thousand fed, the refusal to give a sign, the blind man at Bethsaida, Peter's answer and the call to take up the cross.

questions.text: Why did Jesus say he had compassion on the multitude?
questions.explanation: He said he had compassion on them because they had stayed with him three days and had nothing to eat.

answers.text: They had been with him three days with nothing to eat
They had come a long way for a sign
They had no shepherd to lead them
They were sick with various diseases

questions.text: How many loaves did the disciples have?
questions.explanation: When he asked how many loaves they had, they said, "Seven."

answers.text: Five
Twelve
Seven
Two

questions.text: About how many people had eaten?
questions.explanation: Mark 8:9 says that those who had eaten were about four thousand, and then he sent them away.

answers.text: About five thousand
About four thousand
About two thousand
About seven hundred

questions.text: What did Jesus answer the Pharisees who sought a sign from heaven?
questions.explanation: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said that no sign will be given to this generation.

answers.text: That the sign would come after three days
That they had already seen many signs
That only the prophets receive signs
That no sign would be given to this generation

questions.text: What yeast did Jesus warn his disciples to beware of?
questions.explanation: He warned them, saying, "Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod."

answers.text: The yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod
The yeast of the scribes
The yeast of the chief priests
The yeast of the Gentiles

questions.text: What did the blind man say when he first looked up?
questions.explanation: He looked up and said, "I see men; for I see them like trees walking."

answers.text: That he saw nothing at all
That he saw everyone clearly
That he saw men like trees walking
That he saw a great light

questions.text: According to the disciples, who did men say Jesus was?
questions.explanation: They told him that men said he was John the Baptizer, others Elijah, and others one of the prophets.

answers.text: A scribe who came down from Jerusalem
John the Baptizer, Elijah or one of the prophets
A ruler of the synagogue in Capernaum
A teacher sent by the chief priests

questions.text: What did Peter answer when Jesus asked, "But who do you say that I am?"

answers.text: "You are the Christ."
"You are a prophet."
"You are the Teacher."
"You are Elijah."

questions.text: What did Jesus say to Peter after Peter began to rebuke him?
questions.explanation: Turning around and seeing his disciples, he rebuked Peter and said, "Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men."

answers.text: "You are the rock."
"Do you not yet understand?"
"Have faith in God."
"Get behind me, Satan!"

questions.text: What must someone do who wants to come after him?
questions.explanation: He said that whoever wants to come after him must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow him.

answers.text: Sell his house and his land
Deny himself and take up his cross
Fast and pray for three days
Tell no one about him
